links.outcome: LLM versus conventional random forest accuracy for spine surgery recommendation on same vignettes
links.effect: Zero-shot ChatGPT3.5 RMSE 0.37, AUROC 0.79; random forest RMSE 0.12, AUROC 0.96; fine-tuned LLMs AUROC 0.81-0.90, all below random forest.
links.quote: The random forest model, trained on the structured data, achieved superior performance (RMSE = 0.12, AUROC = 0.96).

unlisted_practices: fine-tuning LLMs on domain-specific data to improve task accuracy

screen.reason: Compares LLMs to random forest models on synthetic clinical vignettes for recommending spine surgery candidacy; evaluates baseline model accuracy without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
